  "rationale": "This is a decision made exactly on the earnings date (asOf = 2026-04-29 = catalyst), so we are trading blind into a binary event with no knowledge of the outcome and, as Risk explicitly notes, no historical earnings-gap distribution to anchor expectancy. The bull case rests on a genuine but modest uptrend (close 2.0% above SMA20, SMA20>SMA50), yet that trend cushion is thin and the single strongest warning is the momentum divergence: +15.7% over 20 days but only +0.4% over the last 5 days, i.e., the advance has clearly stalled into the event. With ATR14 at ~2.4% and earnings gaps capable of exceeding that, a protective stop may be jumped on a gap, making risk/reward asymmetric and unmanageable. The directional edge (slight trend tilt long) is too small to justify risking capital against this event-driven variance. Best to stand aside and re-engage once post-event price action confirms direction.",
  "minorityOpinion": "Bull's trend-continuation thesis is the strongest losing argument: a multi-signal confirmed uptrend (close above a rising SMA20, SMA20 above SMA50, +15.7% 20d momentum, orderly 2.4% ATR) frequently persists through catalysts, so NO_TRADE forgoes a real trend-following edge that would favor a long entry."
